title: The Hungry Bell
author: Mara Amberdale
blurb: Lior Okonkwo, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
